subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Comprehensive Permit
overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals conducted a final review of draft conditions and linkage fee waiver requests for the 350-unit 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway development. The Board voted to close the public hearing, with a final vote on the comprehensive permit scheduled for July 11, 2023.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway (Case 40B-2022-01)
items.summary: The Board reviewed updated permit conditions for the 350-unit residential project, reaching consensus on e-bike storage safety restrictions, phased occupancy, and flexible construction hours coordinated with the building commissioner and police chief.

items.title: Linkage Waiver and Public Benefit Credits
items.summary: The applicant requested approximately $750,000 in credits against required linkage fees for off-site improvements including sewer infrastructure, intersection upgrades, and a Blue Bike station.

items.title: Hearing Closure and Next Steps
items.summary: The Board voted to close the public hearing for the 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway project after receiving final updated waiver and condition lists.
